name: Not subject to ONSS
description: Worker not subject to ONSS (no DmfA declaration).

name: Seasonal worker
description: Temporary workers in horticulture and agriculture (employers registered under categories 194, 494, 594, 193, 293, 097 and 497).

name: Flat-rate paid worker
description: Special category workers to be declared on the basis of flat-rate wages by employers registered under categories 017, 019, 066, 097, 317, 323, 497, 562 and 662 and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: Sheltered workshop worker
description: Manual worker without wage moderation employed in a licensed sheltered workshop or in a 'maatwerkbedrijf' (tailor-made company) registered under category 073, 173, 273, 373, 373 or 673 and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: Taxi driver
description: a) Taxi drivers assigned to passenger transport employed by employers registered under category 068 (wage moderation contribution not due) and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19. b) Contractual workers not subject to the salaried annual leave scheme employed by an employer in category 040.

name: Ordinary manual worker
description: Ordinary category workers and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19: a) to be declared on the basis of actual wages by employers registered under categories 017, 019, 068 or 562 (wage moderation contribution due); b) non-officers declared by employers registered under categories 105, 205, 305, 405 and 505; c) all other workers not mentioned elsewhere.

name: Surface miner
description: Surface miner and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: Underground miner
description: Underground miner and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: Occasional student
description: Occasional special category student workers (see code 011 in categories 317, 097 and 497) until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Career break replacement worker
description: Contractual workers - manual workers hired in the public sector to replace contractual or statutory workers on career break according to the provisions of the recovery law of 22 January 1985 or to replace workers who reduce their working hours by 1/5th with a compensatory bonus within the framework of work redistribution in the public sector.

name: Occasional apprentice under 18
description: Special category apprentice workers until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Subsidized contractual worker
description: Subsidized contractuals, manual workers declared on the basis of actual remuneration (see code 015 point b))

name: Subsidized contractual sheltered workshop worker
description: Subsidized contractuals, manual workers without wage moderation employed in a licensed sheltered workshop or a 'maatwerkbedrijf' (tailor-made company) registered under category 073, 173, 273, 373, 473 or 673.

name: Ordinary student/trainee
description: Ordinary category student workers and trainees (see code 015) until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Subsidized contractual flat-rate worker
description: Subsidized contractuals, manual workers declared on the basis of a flat-rate remuneration employed by public authorities and other assimilated establishments, associations and companies.

name: Apprentice manual worker under 18
description: Apprentices and assimilated manual workers until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Domestic staff
description: Household staff, manual workers, declared by employers registered under categories 039, 094, 193, 099 and 299.

name: Domestic staff (student)
description: Household staff, student workers (see code 043) until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Domestic worker
description: Domestic workers declared by employers registered under category 037 or 437.

name: Artist
description: Artists and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: Artist student
description: Artists - Part-time students until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Flexi-job manual worker
description: Manual workers employed under a flexi-job contract.

name: CPAS manual worker (Art.60)
description: Manual workers hired under art. 60 § 7 of the organic law of CPAS (Public Centers for Social Action) of 8 July 1976.

name: CPAS employee (Art.60)
description: Intellectual workers hired under art. 60 § 7 of the organic law of CPAS (Public Centers for Social Action) of 8 July 1976.

name: Casino employee
description: Casino employees.

name: Unprotected local representative
description: Unprotected local representatives.

name: Protected local representative
description: Protected local representatives.

name: Member of parliament
description: Member of a federal or regional parliament.

name: Member of government
description: Member of a federal or regional government.

name: Apprentice employee
description: Apprentices and assimilated intellectual workers until December 31 of the year they turn 18.

name: Flexi-job employee
description: Intellectual workers employed under a flexi-job contract.

name: Paid athlete
description: From the year they turn 19: Paid athletes under Joint Committee 329.

name: Career break replacement employee
description: Contractual workers - employees hired in the public sector to replace contractual or statutory workers on career break according to the provisions of the recovery law of 22 January 1985 or to replace workers who reduce their working hours by 1/5th with a compensatory bonus within the framework of work redistribution in the public sector.

name: Subsidized contractual employee
description: Subsidized contractuals, intellectual workers employed by public authorities and other assimilated establishments, associations and companies.

name: Subsidized contractual sheltered workshop employee
description: Subsidized contractuals, manual workers without wage moderation employed in a licensed sheltered workshop or a 'maatwerkbedrijf' (tailor-made company) registered under category 073, 173, 273, 373, 473 or 673.

name: Flat-rate paid student
description: Occasional student employees to be declared on the basis of flat-rate wages by employers registered under categories 317, 097 and 497.

name: Student/foreign worker
description: Students a) Employees and trainees until December 31 of the year they turn 18. b) Workers, until December 31 of the year they turn 18, regardless of their activity, who are not covered by Belgian labour legislation, to be declared by employers with employer category 212.

name: (Post)doctoral scholarship holder (Fedris)
description: Recipients of a (post)doctoral scholarship granted by an employer cited in art. 3bis or 15 of the Royal Decree of 28/11/1969 (Fedris contributions due).

name: (Post)doctoral scholarship holder outside EU (no paid leave)
description: Recipients of a (post)doctoral scholarship from a country outside the European Economic Area that does not have agreements with Belgium and are not subject to the private sector annual leave scheme.

name: Free university staff
description: Non-administrative and technical staff of free universities subject to all social security schemes.

name: Sheltered workshop employee
description: Employees without wage moderation employed in a licensed sheltered workshop or a 'maatwerkbedrijf' (tailor-made company) registered under category 073, 173, 273, 373, 373 or 673 and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19.

name: University academic staff
description: Academic and scientific staff of universities registered under categories 175, 396 and 075. Contractuals not subject to the salaried annual leave scheme in categories 040 and 075.

name: Paid athlete in the public sector
description: From the year they turn 19: Paid athletes under Joint Committees 223 or 200 or in the public sector.

name: Ordinary employee
description: Employees and apprentices in this category from the year they turn 19: a) Ordinary category employees; b) Paid athletes, limited to football coaches and referees, declared by employers registered under categories 070 or 076; c) Officers declared by employers registered under categories 105, 205, 305, 405 and 505; d) Workers, regardless of their activity, who are not covered by Belgian labor legislation, to be declared by employers with employer category 212.

name: Occasional flat-rate paid employee
description: Occasional employees declared on the basis of flat-rate wages by employers registered under categories 317, 097 and 497.

name: Licensed childminder
description: Licensed childminders.

name: (Post)doctoral scholarship holder outside EU (with paid leave)
description: Recipients of a (post)doctoral scholarship from a country outside the European Economic Area that does not have agreements with Belgium and are subject to the private sector annual leave scheme.

name: Public service representative
description: Representatives or staff members in public services.

name: Health care insurance only
description: Workers subject only to Health Care insurance.

name: Statutory worker assigned abroad
description: Statutory workers with a place of assignment abroad.

name: Trainee for permanent appointment
description: Trainees for permanent appointment with the private sector leave scheme at a provincial or local administration.

name: Permanent doctor (no ONSS)
description: Permanent doctors exempt from social security contributions based on art. 1, § 3 of the law of 27.6.1969 and who, based on art. 158 of the hospital law of 10-07-2008, are entitled to a public pension.

name: Student manual worker
description: Student workers (manual) for whom the solidarity contribution for students employed under a student employment contract is due.

name: Student employee
description: Student workers (intellectual) for whom the solidarity contribution for students employed under a student employment contract is due.

name: Former employee in bridging pension with company supplement
description: Worker in a bridging pension scheme (RCC) for whom a special contribution is due.

name: Dismissed worker with supplementary indemnity
description: Dismissed workers for whom a contribution on supplementary indemnities is due.

name: Worker on career break with supplementary indemnity
description: Workers on career break for whom a contribution on supplementary indemnities is due.

name: Manual worker trainee in training (no ONSS)
description: Workers who perform work in Belgium as part of a training program for paid employment but who are not subject to the Belgian social security system.

name: Employee trainee in training (no ONSS)
description: Employees who perform work in Belgium as part of a training program for paid employment but who are not subject to the Belgian social security system.
